rows.prose: What property makes a static prop block precomputed visibility in Hammer?
rows.keywords: static prop vis occluder precomputed visibility
rows.evidence: field name "visoccluder", label "Vis Occluder", description: "If true this geometry is used as an occluder for precomputed visibility. As a rule this geometry should be as simplistic as possible"

rows.prose: How does VIS work in Source 2 and which geometry contributes to it?
rows.keywords: VIS visibility contributors static prop occluder
rows.evidence: "By default, all meshes are VIS contributors, which can be disabled by selecting \"Exclude from VIS\". Static props are the inverse, and you can set them as VIS contributors by marking the \"Vis Occluder\" property."

rows.prose: Why does editing my cs_script JavaScript file not change the map?
rows.keywords: cs_script compiled vjs_c loaded map load recompile
rows.evidence: "The compiled version of your script (.vjs_c) will be loaded during map load." and under Tools Mode: "In tools mode, saving changes to your script will recompile your file, clear all registered callbacks, and re-run the top level scope of your script."
rows.source: user ask (e) recompiling cs_script / baked vjs do nothing

rows.prose: What is a VPK and where does the game load its content from?
rows.keywords: vpk valve pak archive format content
rows.evidence: "A VPK (Valve Pak) is the uncompressed archive format Source and Source 2 package content in. Almost everything a game loads at runtime comes out of one." (also: content lives in the game's content archives pak01_dir.vpk, every compiled map, and workshop items/addons)
rows.source: user ask (e) baked vpk source does nothing

rows.prose: How do I get rid of compiled output that a map build produced?
rows.keywords: deleting the map's vpk game side
rows.evidence: "Turning a stage off does not undo it: deleting the map's `.vpk` from the [`game/`](./content-and-game.md) side is the only way to get rid of what it produced."
rows.source: user ask (e) stale/baked output does nothing

rows.prose: Why is my edit to a file under the game/ folder ignored?
rows.keywords: content side vs game side which to edit recompile
rows.evidence: "**`content/`** holds authored source files. Nothing here is ever loaded by the game." ... "The source file is edited under `content/`, a compiler writes the compiled result to the matching path under `game/`, and the game loads that." and "Almost always the `content` side is the right one to edit"
rows.source: user ask (e) editing baked source does nothing

rows.prose: What is a Source 2 addon and where does its content live?
